**PDU session establishment**

| | |
|---|---|
| Group | NAS / UE-requested 5GSM procedures / UE-requested PDU session establishment procedure |
| Tags | none |
| Verdict class | FAIL |
| Requires | Rel-15 |
| Up to | 30s at the default `--per-test-timeout` |
| Phase | main |
| Owns | PDU session establishment |
| Needs | NG Setup, registration |

## Clauses

- TS 24.501 6.4.1.3 (Rel-15 onward, wording unchanged through Rel-19)
- TS 24.501 6.4.1.4.1 (6.4.1.4 in V15.1.0 to V15.7.0) (Rel-15 onward; Rel-15: V15.0.0 has 6.4.1.4.1; in V15.7.0 the text sits directly in 6.4.1.4; V15.x reads "a SM PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REJECT"; Rel-16: 6.4.1.4.1 again, without "SM"; the sentence is otherwise unchanged through V19.8.0)

The quoted normative text and the release history of each clause are in the check's [provenance](https://github.com/grewelltech/orbit/blob/main/docs/conformance/provenance/NAS-PDU-SESSION-ESTABLISHMENT.md).
